title: Rusty Sword
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Bent near the crossguard where a Thornwick taxman tried to parry a cartwheel.
Pitted by river fog along the Border Fords. Still keen enough to settle tavern debts, though the tang rattles inside its shrunken hide grip.

title: Iron Sword
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Issued to Alder Bridge pickets before the spring floods washed their barracks away.
Forged from bog-smelted ore that smudges oiled rags. Dependable if you keep the bevel away from granite and bone.

title: Steel Sword
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Balanced by a Greywood smith who lost three fingers testing its temper.
A clean fuller runs two-thirds down the flat, singing faintly when drawn. Watchmen in Oakhaven trade two months' scrip for metalwork this honest.

title: Knight Sword
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: The pommel bears a filed-off crest from a disgraced Border Fords barony.
Watered alloy folded until faint ripples show beneath the grease. Whoever owned it before died with their visor up and their purse still buckled.

title: Thorn Blade
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Grown rather than forged; sap still beads along its serrated fuller.
Cut from a petrified briar at the root of the Sunken Sanctum. Flesh parts around its jagged teeth as if eager to escape the edge.

title: Oak Staff
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Charred at the ferrule where an apprentice mistook swamp gas for hearth smoke.
Seasoned bog-timber bound in tarnished wire. It smells of wet bark and scorched eyebrows whenever sparks gather at its crown.

title: Ash Staff
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Carved with tally marks by a Redmarsh hedge-witch who stopped counting at forty.
Heartwood stripped from lightning-split trees. Channeling through it feels like holding a taut bowstring in a sleet storm.

title: Rune Staff
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Its inlaid glyphs hum low enough to loosen fillings in nearby teeth.
Etched by Lantern Passage scholars before the ink-vaults flooded. Each sigil drinks ambient warmth, leaving rime on the wielder's knuckles.

title: Star Staff
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Crowned with a meteorite shard that refuses to cool even in river ice.
Recovered from a crater north of the Iron Coast. Staring directly at its fractured core leaves violet afterimages across the battlefield.

title: Thorn Staff
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Roots coil tightly around a core that twitches near spilled blood.
Harvested from the living gallows of the Ember Court. It murmurs in dead dialects when fed aether, tightening its clasp on the caster's wrist.

title: Wooden Buckler
infobox: Act I Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Planked from an ale cask; the inside still smells of sour barley.
Reinforced with a single boss hammered flat on an anvil stone. Good for turning aside a cudgel, hopeless against anything weightier.

title: Iron Shield
infobox: Act I–II Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Dented inward by a boar tusk at the edge of the Greywood.
Rim-bound oak faced with hammered grey sheet. Burdensome on the forearm after a league's march, yet comforting when arrows start falling.

title: Tower Shield
infobox: Act II–III Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Scorched along the lower rim from holding a burning doorway at Ravenwatch.
Tall enough to kneel behind while quarrels splinter against the planks. Two painted eyes stare from the front, one half-scraped off by shrapnel.

title: Knight Shield
infobox: Act III–IV Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Polished to a dull mirror despite three gouges across the heraldry.
Laminated ash beneath fluted plate built to deflect lance tips. The arm-straps are padded with wolfskin rubbed smooth by gauntlets.

title: Leather Cap
infobox: Act I Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Stitched from boiled bullhide with one ear-flap chewed off by kennel pups.
Cracked along the crown where rain dried too fast beside a campfire. Better than bare scalp when sling-stones start dropping.

title: Iron Helm
infobox: Act I–II Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: The nasal bar is bent slightly left, forcing the wearer to cock their head.
Riveted from two halves over a greasy wool liner. Every blow against the dome rings like a cracked chapel bell inside your skull.

title: Steel Helm
infobox: Act III–IV Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Slotted visor hinges still hold dried salt from the Iron Coast garrisons.
Angled cheek-plates guide blade tips away from the throat. Veterans keep a spare chin-strap tucked inside the crown just in case.

title: Scholar Hat
infobox: Act I–II Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Moth-eaten brim stiffened with wax and stained with violet ink.
Used by census clerks who accompanied early expeditions into Redmarsh. The wide brim keeps drizzle off parchment, though little else.

title: Wizard Hat
infobox: Act III–IV Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Sewn from midnight felt lined with copper thread that crackles in dry wind.
Its crooked peak leans away from drafty corridors and incoming hexes alike. Dust motes orbit the brim when spells are being readied.

title: Padded Jerkin
infobox: Act I Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Stuffed with horsehair and tow; smells strongly of wet sheep in the rain.
Quilted canvas worn beneath mail or alone by penniless recruits. Stops splinters and shallow cuts while catching every burr in the fen.

title: Chain Mail
infobox: Act I–II Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Thousands of riveted links, twelve of them replaced with mismatched brass wire.
Taken off a deserter who drowned trying to swim the Thornwick ford. Weighty across the shoulders, chill as a grave at dawn.

title: Plate Armor
infobox: Act III–IV Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Articulated lames blackened with soot to hide bright metal during night marches.
Fitted by Ironcamp armorers who charge by the pound and never bargain. A direct mace blow still bruises, though your ribs stay whole.

title: Cloth Robe
infobox: Act I Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hemmed with mud from a dozen Border Fords ditches and patched at both elbows.
Unbleached homespun dyed with walnut hulls. Offers no shelter from blades, only pockets for chalk, dried roots, and tallow stubs.

title: Mage Robe
infobox: Act II–III Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Woven with silver-dipped silk that sheds bog-water like a duck's back.
Tailored for Oakhaven tower adepts who disliked scorched cuffs. Faint wards stitched into the seams tingle when hostile magic draws near.

title: Star Robe
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Velvet dusted with crushed moonstone that glitters only in shadow.
Looped with gold wire tracing constellations no longer visible over Thornvael. Arrows seem to hesitate a fraction before striking its folds.

title: Sandals
infobox: Act I Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Thongs cut from frayed bridle hide, mended twice with tarred twine.
Built for dry cobbles rather than ankle-deep fen sludge. At least they dry out fast beside a banked fire.

title: Leather Boots
infobox: Act I–II Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hobnailed soles ground smooth on the outer heels from long patrol routes.
Greased calfskin reaching mid-calf to keep leeches out of your hose. Every mercenary in Thornwick knows good boots outlast good vows.

title: Iron Boots
infobox: Act II–III Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Sabaton plates clack like a skeleton dancing on flagstones.
Articulated metal over thick hide soles meant for holding narrow breaches. Nobody runs in them, and nobody easily pushes you backward.

title: Swift Boots
infobox: Act III–IV Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Supple elkhide stitched with sinew so light they barely press the mud.
Favored by couriers running dispatches between Oakhaven and the coast. The soles leave almost no heel-print even in damp clay.

title: Ring of Might
infobox: Act I–II Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Band hammered around a sliver of lodestone.
Belonged to a pit-fighter in Thornwick until a debt collector took his finger. Warm to the touch whenever muscles strain.

title: Ring of Grace
infobox: Act I–II Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Twisted silver wire thin enough to bend if squeezed between two thumbs.
Found in the velvet jewelry box of an Ember Court dancer. The band settles naturally against the knuckle, steadying trembling hands.

title: Ring of Insight
infobox: Act I–II Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Set with a cloudy beryl that clears briefly whenever a lie is spoken nearby.
Forged for archivists cataloging the Undervault ruins. Wearing it makes lamp-light seem sharper and margins easier to read.

title: Ring of Calm
infobox: Act I–II Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: River-pebble band carved from a single piece of jade.
Given to watchmen stationed along the howling cliffs of Iron Coast. Pulse-beats slow against its cool inner surface.

title: Great Ring of Might
infobox: Act III–IV Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Twin bands of meteoric ore welded over a pulsing garnet core.
Once belonged to a siege-breaker who lifted a portcullis alone at Alder Bridge. Heat radiates into the tendons of the sword-arm.

title: Great Ring of Grace
infobox: Act III–IV Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Filigree platinum loop that feels lighter than the air it displaces.
Crafted by blind jewelers of the pre-Ashen court. Wearers move as though wind were always at their heels.

title: Great Ring of Insight
infobox: Act III–IV Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: An unblinking sapphire set in gold that reflects rooms differently.
Recovered from a drowned observatory beneath Redmarsh. Thoughts line up like soldiers on parade while it rests on your hand.

title: Great Ring of Calm
infobox: Act III–IV Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Obsidian hoop veined with silver that swallows nearby clatter.
Carried by inquisitors during Ember Court trials to keep their hands steady. Panic slides off the mind like rain off slate.

title: Ember Charm
infobox: Act I–II Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Charred bone pendant enclosing a cinder that has glowed for thirty winters.
Hung around the necks of charcoal burners working the Greywood. Keeps frostbite from the fingers even when campfires die.

title: Frost Charm
infobox: Act I–II Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Rime-coated glass vial holding a single snowflake suspended in oil.
Traded down from northern whalers who wrecked along the Ferric Coast. Cold sweats bead on the chain whenever flames flare close.

title: Storm Charm
infobox: Act I–II Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Fulgerite shard bound in copper wire that smells sharply of ozone.
Picked from a blasted oak outside Ravenwatch. The pendant jerks northward seconds before thunder cracks overhead.

title: Stone Charm
infobox: Act I–II Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Chipped granite disc carved with a mason's plumb-line and three dots.
Carried by quarrymen in the pits of Redmarsh to ward off cave-ins. Feels twice as weighty whenever ground begins to tremble.

title: Life Charm
infobox: Act II–III Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Braided red thread coiled around a seed that still rattles inside its husk.
Sold by midwives in Thornwick after bad harvests. Its warmth steadies shallow breathing when bandages run red.

title: Mind Charm
infobox: Act II–III Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Tarnished argent locket containing a folded scrap of mirrored foil.
Kept by Lantern Passage scribes during all-night vigils. Keeps fog from creeping behind the eyes after days without sleep.

title: Ward Charm
infobox: Act III–IV Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Lead-sealed brass talisman stamped with four crossed keys.
Issued to captains marching against Ember Court hexers. The pendant grows scalding hot just before a curse strikes home.

title: Healing Draught
infobox: Act I Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Tastes like boiled nettles and copper pennies; do not sniff before swallowing.
Brewed in clay jugs by Thornwick apothecaries. Knits torn meat together fast enough to itch, leaving puckered scars behind.

title: Greater Healing Draught
infobox: Act II–III Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Thick as tallow and glowing faintly pink; swirl well or chew the sediment.
Distilled from red-cap moss harvested only after Redmarsh blood-rains. Closes gashes in seconds while leaving your tongue numb for hours.

title: Mana Draught
infobox: Act I Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Fizzy blue brine that turns your teeth indigo and makes your ears ring.
Steeped from crushed glow-lichen scraped off Undervault pillars. Restores spent focus at the cost of a brief, sharp headache.

title: Greater Mana Draught
infobox: Act II–III Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Smells of crushed stars and vinegar; never drink within an hour of open flame.
Refined in glass retorts by Oakhaven alchemists. Floods parched channels with clarity until sparks dance off your fingernails.

title: Elixir of Body
infobox: Act III–IV Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Swallow in one gulp; spitting it out wastes coin and stains floorboards forever.
Boiled down from marrow, filings, and bitter root. Leaves muscles tight as drawn bowstrings long after the bottle is empty.

title: Elixir of Agility
infobox: Act III–IV Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Shimmers like mercury in the phial and makes your knees twitch before uncorking.
Compounded with wasp venom and distilled fen-mint. The world seems to drag its feet for a heartbeat after the last drop goes down.

title: Elixir of Mind
infobox: Act III–IV Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Clear as rain until tilted, revealing tiny motes that spell forgotten words.
Brewed in silence by hooded archivists of Lantern Passage. Sharpens recall until every old mistake feels freshly minted.

title: Elixir of Spirit
infobox: Act III–IV Quartermasters, Belt Drops & Field Loot Sacks

p: Warm as mulled wine and thick with gold leaf that clings to the throat.
Blessed over braziers in the chapels before the Ember Court schism. Steadies the nerve against terror and hex-rot alike.

title: Scroll of Fire Bolt
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Keep arid; damp parchment tends to ignite inside the scroll-case instead.
Hurls a bolt of ash-fire at a foe (reach 7), dealing 16-24 fire damage. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
Inscribed in soot-ink on cured sheepskin. Speaking the final syllable looses a whistling dart of searing ember.
A pinched coal-spark loosed down a copper-bound ley-line.

title: Scroll of Fireball
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Singed around all four margins by the scribe who proofread the last verse.
Launches an explosive sphere at the ground (reach 8, radius 2), dealing 18-28 fire damage. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
Bound with crimson waxed cord and smelling strongly of sulfur. Unfurls a roaring sphere that turns tight formations into ash and grease.
Pressurized tallow-gas and sulfur igniting in a tight red bloom.

title: Scroll of Flame Burst
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Read aloud at arm's length unless you prefer eyebrows painted on with charcoal.
Splits into up to 3 fiery shards within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 12-18 fire damage each. Cost: 12, CD: 35.
Drafted by siege-mages during the Alder Bridge defense. Releases a sudden ring of scorching heat around the caster's boots.
Three splintered embers seeking dry wool, oiled leather, and flesh.

title: Scroll of Ignite
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Even holding the rolled vellum makes seasoned tinder curl in nearby pockets.
Sets a foe ablaze (reach 6), inflicting burn (2) for 6s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
A terse three-line incantation favored by Redmarsh scouts. Sets oil, pitch, and wool ablaze with a snap of the thumb.
Slow pitch-flame that clings to wet cloth and chars bone beneath.

title: Scroll of Frost Bolt
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Rime forms along the wax seal whenever the scroll is carried indoors.
Strikes a foe with river-ice (reach 7) for 12-18 water damage and slows for 8s. Cost: 8, CD: 30.
Written with pewter-ash ink on bleached vellum. Launches a needle of black ice that numbs limbs on impact.
A needle of cistern-ice drawn from winter's deep pressure.

title: Tome of Ice Storm
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Its clasped covers are welded shut with frost that never melts.
Pelts an area with sleet (reach 8, radius 2.5) for 10-16 damage, slowing foes for 6s. Cost: 16, CD: 45.
Recovered from a frozen watchtower north of the Smelted Coast. Calls down jagged hailstones stout enough to dent helm crowns.
Sleet and jagged hail sheared from the upper mountain winds.

title: Scroll of Chain Frost
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: The ink shifts across the page like frost patterns creeping over glass.
Bounces across 4 foes in radius 3.5 (reach 7) for 9-14 damage, slowing for 4s. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
Annotated in trembling handwriting by an Oakhaven winter-adept. Releases a bouncing shard of cold that leaps from shield to shield.
Cold leaps from damp cloak to damp cloak like river-freeze.

title: Scroll of Healing
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Smells faintly of crushed sage and clean linen amid battlefield mud.
Mends an ally's wounds (reach 7), restoring 30-45 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
Copied by field chaplains who followed the Border Fords levies. Mends torn sinew and stops bleeding before shock sets in.
Warmth coaxed back into torn sinew with a steady pulse of mana.

title: Tome of Healing Rain
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Pages stay perpetually damp, smelling of summer storms over open fields.
Showers a 3-radius area (reach 8), restoring 14-22 HP to allies within. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 50.
Bound in oiled sealskin for coastal campaigns. Summons a mercury-bright mist that washes grime and shallow wounds from an entire company.
Clean mountain mist that washes grime and fever from the line.

title: Scroll of Lightning
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Hair on the forearms stands straight up the moment the ribbon is untied.
Strikes a foe with a high-voltage arc (reach 8) for 24-34 air damage. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 35.
Scratched onto copper-leaf parchment during a squall. Calls a jagged fork down from even a cloudless sky.
A grounded arc of telluric current snapping to iron helms.

title: Tome of Chain Lightning
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Smells of burnt hair and ozone; store well away from scabbards.
Arcs across 4 targets within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 14-22 air damage. Cost: 16, CD: 40.
Chained inside a lead box until the Ironcamp siege. Arcs violently from one armored target to the next until grounded.
High-voltage discharge hopping across wet mail and raised pikes.

title: Scroll of Haste
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: The calligraphy slants forward so sharply the words nearly run off the page.
Quickens an ally's stride and swing (reach 7) with haste for 25s. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 30.
Drafted by courier-mages who hated late dispatches. Quickens pulse and stride until blades blur in the air.
Tightens the breath and quickens tired legs before the breach.

title: Scroll of Gale
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Fluttering edges snap like a mainsail even inside a shuttered cellar.
Buffets a 3-radius area (reach 8) for 8-12 air damage and slows foes for 5s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
Used by Wrought-ore Coast harbor pilots to clear fog banks. Uncorks a battering blast of wind that bowls pikemen backward.
A bitter marsh squall that fouls bowstrings and staggers shields.

title: Scroll of Wind Ward
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Light as a dried gull feather and impossible to lay flat on a table.
Sheathes the caster in whirling air, granting a 35-point shield for 45s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
Inscribed along the cliffs above Burning Harbor. Wraps allies in screaming crosswinds that turn arrows harmlessly aside.
A humming pressure-shell that turns aside slung stone and bolt.

title: Scroll of Rock Throw
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Gritty quartz dust spills from the folds every time the parchment bends.
Hurls a jagged chunk of granite at a foe (reach 7) for 18-26 earth damage. Cost: 9, CD: 32.
A blunt peasant-hedge formula favored by quarry foremen. Hurls a fist-sized stone with the punch of a torsion sling.
Basalt wrenched from the earth and hurled with siege-arm force.

title: Tome of Stone Curse
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Burdened like a milestone and cold enough to numb bare fingers.
Calcifies a foe (reach 6), petrifying them into stone for 5s. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.
Chiseled onto thin slate leaves bound with bronze rings. Turns rushing flesh sluggish and grey before locking joints solid.
Calcifies joint and marrow until a soldier stands as limestone.

title: Scroll of Stone Skin
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: The vellum feels rough as pumice and dulls any quill drawn across it.
Hardens an ally's flesh (reach 7) with a 50-point earth shield for 45s. Cost: 10, CD: 30.
Copied from boundary markers in the Deep Quarry. Hardens skin into pebbled grit that blunts shallow cuts.
Hardens bruised hide with a crust of compressed quarry-slate.

title: Scroll of Poison Cloud
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Sealed in oiled bladder-skin; yellow vapor leaks if the wax cracks.
Fills a 2.5-radius area (reach 8) with toxic marsh gas, poisoning (1) for 12s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
Brewed from swamp-adder bile and rotting bog-turnips. Fills a hollow with choking green fumes that rot lungs and hide alike.
Stagnant peat-fume and copperas drifting low over the mud.

title: Tome of Quake
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Bookshelves shudder and dust sifts from rafters wherever this volume rests.
Ruptures the ground (reach 7, radius 3.5), dealing 20-30 earth damage. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 60.
Bound in riveted plates stamped with broken towers. Splits flagstones and topples shield-walls in a rolling roar.
Strikes the bedrock seam until palisades and kneecaps buckle.

title: Scroll of Blessing
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Gold leaf along the margin stays bright even in the filthiest trench.
Steadies an ally's hand and spirit (reach 7), granting bless for 60s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
Distributed by Oakhaven chaplains before dawn assaults. Steadies wavering ranks with brief, fierce certainty.
Steadies the sword-hand with a cold oath of the First Watch.

title: Scroll of Weaken
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Written in faded gall-ink that makes the reader's shoulders slump.
Saps a foe's sinews (reach 7), inflicting weaken for 30s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
Used by Ember Court tax-enforcers to break stubborn holdouts. Saps muscle and resolve until shields drag in the dirt.
Bleeds iron-will from the limbs like a cracked tallow lamp.

title: Tome of Resurrect
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Pages whisper names of the recently dead whenever left open at night.
Calls a fallen combatant back from a corpse (reach 6). Cost: 30 mana, CD: 75.
Forbidden by three synods and hidden beneath the Sunken Sanctum. Drags a fresh corpse back to ragged, furious breath.
Reclaims a fresh corpse under Third-Dynasty probate bone-law.

title: Scroll of Corpse Burst
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Smells faintly of lard and saltpeter; do not read near exposed graves.
Detonates a corpse (reach 7, radius 2.5), dealing 18-26 astral damage. Cost: 14, CD: 50.
Scrawled by a frantic necromancer cornered in Redmarsh. Turns fallen bodies into shrapnel of splintered bone and boiling blood.
Ruptures trapped gas in a fallen carcass, scything nearby foes.

title: Scroll of Meditation
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Reading the first line slows your breathing; reading the last empties your purse.
Centers the mind to restore 12 mana to the caster. Cost: 0 mana, CD: 250.
Copied in calm, even script by Lantern Passage hermits. Quiets battlefield clamor so spent focus pools back swiftly.
Slows the pulse to draw stray current from the damp earth.

title: Leather Gloves
infobox: Act I Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Stiffened around the knuckles from gripping wet reins and tarnished hilts.
Tanned pigskin stitched with waxed linen. Keeps blisters off palms during forced marches through the Border Fords.

title: Iron Gauntlets
infobox: Act I–II Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Articulated finger-plates rattle softly against wooden spear-shafts.
Riveted over dense buckskin mittens by Thornwick smiths. Turns a backhand punch into a solid blow with metal knuckles.

title: Steel Gauntlets
infobox: Act III–IV Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Fluted cuffs bear notch-marks where a mercenary counted his winter contracts.
Fitted closely enough to draw a bowstring yet sturdy enough to parry a dagger. Oiled weekly to keep sea-spray from seizing the rivets.

title: Silk Gloves
infobox: Act II–III Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Dyed plum with lunate-thread cuffs that never catch on scroll ribbons.
Woven in Oakhaven for channelers whose fingers blister from raw aether. The fabric stays cool even when sparks dance across the palms.

title: Mithril Gale Buckler
infobox: Act II–III Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Featherweight as a tin platter yet rings like an anvil when struck square.
Hammered from mountain alloy etched with wind-spirals. Deflects incoming bolts with a sharp whistling whine.

title: Adamantium Needle
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: A slender estoc that slides between mail rings without a sound.
Forged in a lost foundry beneath the Pig-metal Coast. Built not for hacking, but for finding the narrow gap under a gorget.

title: Dragon Leather Mantle
infobox: Act III–IV Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Scales along the shoulders still smell faintly of sulfur and sodden ash.
Cured from a drake carcass dragged out of the Redmarsh sinkholes. Sizzling sparks and lamp-oil bead harmlessly off its pebbled hide.

title: Tome of Meteor
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Singed calfskin bound in blackened metal that radiates tinder-crisp furnace heat.
Calls down a molten crag (reach 8, radius 3) for 32-48 damage and burn (4) for 8s. Cost: 26, CD: 70.
Penultimate work of a mad Ember Court astronomer. Calls a screaming lump of slag down from the upper dark.
Calls down white-hot caldera slag to crush shield-walls flat.

title: Scroll of Inferno
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: The wax seal melts into scarlet tears whenever enemies draw within twenty paces.
Engulfs up to 5 foes in radius 4 (reach 7) for 22-34 fire damage each. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 45.
Inscribed with charcoal harvested from burned chapels. Turns an entire patch of ground into a roaring kiln.
Unleashes pent-up furnace draft across five choked targets.

title: Tome of Blizzard
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Icicles form along the spine whenever the book is opened indoors.
Unleashes a freezing gale (reach 8, radius 3.5) for 20-30 damage, slowing for 10s. Cost: 24, CD: 65.
Recovered from a shipwreck locked in northern pack-ice. Blankets the field in blinding sleet that freezes boots to the mud.
Buries a whole crossing in blinding sleet and frostbite.

title: Tome of Thunderstorm
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Static arcs between the brass corners whenever rainclouds gather.
Strikes 4 foes in radius 4 (reach 8) with 26-38 air damage each. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 50.
Chained to a lightning-rod atop Oakhaven's tallest spire. Unleashes rolling thunderbolts across an entire valley.
Four merciless sky-bolts hunting every copper buckle in range.

title: Scroll of Iron Skin
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Written on hammered tin-foil rather than parchment; creases scream loudly.
Encases the caster in living plate, granting a 100-point shield for 60s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 60.
Issued to vanguard stormers at Ironcamp Citadel. Turns flesh temporarily dull grey and hard as frigid pig-ore-cast.
Plates the body in tempered slag-sheen that turns keen steel.

title: Scroll of Acid Rain
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Eats slowly through ordinary scroll-cases; keep wrapped in oiled canvas.
Corrosive downpour (reach 8, radius 3.5) dealing 14-20 damage and poison (2) for 16s. Cost: 20, CD: 55.
Brewed from vitriol recipes stolen out of Redmarsh laboratories. Brings down a hissing drizzle that pits plate and blisters skin.
Vitriol-laced drizzle that pits iron plate and blisters skin.

title: Scroll of Mana Burn
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: The ink glows violet and tastes bitter on the air when unrolled.
Ignites a foe's internal aether (reach 7), dealing 25-40 astral damage. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 40.
Devised by witch-hunters hunting rogue Ember Court adepts. Detonates a caster's gathered power inside their own skull.
Shorts an enemy caster's ward-coil, scorching mind and marrow.

title: Tome of Time Warp
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Its pages yellow and turn crisp again in the span of a solitary heartbeat.
Bends the local hour around the caster, granting haste for 40s. Cost: 25 mana, CD: 80.
Found ticking inside a sealed vault beneath the Sunken Citadel. Warps local seconds until allies strike twice before a foe blinks.
Overclocks the blood-beat until arrows seem to crawl in air.

title: Woodcutter Handaxe
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Nicked near the heel from hitting a buried horseshoe in Greywood.
Short hickory haft wedged tight with a metal shim. Meant for kindling, yet plenty lethal in a cramped ditch.

title: Bearded Battleaxe
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: The lower hook is ground shiny from dragging shields down in melee.
Broad crescent head balanced for one-handed swings. Redmarsh raiders favor it because it splits rain-soaked oak planks with one chop.

title: Tempered War Axe
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Blue-ashen edge honed on river slate until it shaves hair unmoistened.
Forged in Oakhaven with a reinforced poll for cracking helms. Nimble enough to recover quickly after a missed overhead strike.

title: Crescent Broadaxe
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Two-handed haft wrapped in tarred cord where blood once made wood slick.
Sweeping curved bit built to shear through pike shafts and mail alike. Leaves a whistling wake every time it clears the shoulder.

title: Berserker Decapitator
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Notched along the spine where its former owner chewed the blade before charges.
Brutally forward-heavy cleaver stained near the rivets. Built for men who have already decided not to walk back.

title: Spiked Cudgel
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Seasoned ash knot studded with square-headed coffin nails.
Cheap, ugly, and brutally effective against hide and bone. Every levy camp outside Thornwick has a dozen leaning by the fire.

title: Flanged Mace
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Six fins bent slightly from hammering against Forged-ore Coast plate.
Designed to cave in helmets where sword edges merely glance off. A wrist-loop keeps it from flying out of numb fingers.

title: Heavy Morningstar
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Dried fen-moss still clings between the spikes of its flanged head.
Ash shaft banded with metal straps to survive parries. Punches clean holes through shield bosses and breastplates alike.

title: Steel Warhammer
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Long rear beak darkened from prying apart riveted mail links.
Compact head concentrating all its weight behind a narrow striking face. Favored by Ironcamp sergeants facing armored veterans.

title: Obsidian Greatmaul
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Volcanic glass bound in black bronze that rings like struck crystal.
Quarried from the charred slopes near the Ember Court. Each blow sends numbing shockwaves straight through shield arms.

title: Flint Stiletto
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Knapped glassy blade lashed to a bone handle with sinew.
Brittle against plate, ruthless in the dark between ribs. Snaps cleanly if twisted, leaving a jagged souvenir inside.

title: Steel Rondel
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Twin disc guards keep blood-slick fingers from sliding onto the triangular blade.
Built solely for punching through mail rings and visor slits. Every mercenary carries one as a final argument in the mud.

title: Duelist Poignard
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Etched along the ricasso with the motto of a ruined Oakhaven fencing hall.
Parrying dagger balanced to catch and trap heavier blades. Quick enough to dart past a guard before a wrist turns.

title: Main-Gauche
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Swept knuckle-bow scarred by dozens of caught sword-edges.
Left-hand companion blade crafted for Slag-metal Coast duelists. Turns aside cuts while leaving the wielder's main hand free.

title: Shadow Dirk
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Soot-blackened metal that swallows torchlight instead of gleaming.
Issued to Ember Court whisper-agents operating behind enemy lines. Leaves glacial, bloodless punctures that ache extended after closing.

title: Two-Handed Claymore
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Quatrefoil crossguard bent slightly from levering unsealed a barred gate.
Lengthy plain blade requiring two hands and plenty of room to swing. Clears a wide semicircle through crowded ranks.

title: Bastard Greatsword
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Wire-wrapped grip ground down to bare beechwood near the pommel.
Hand-and-a-half blade flexible enough for shield work or sweeping two-handed cuts. Popular among Border Fords veterans.

title: Flamberge
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Undulating edge leaves ragged wounds that resist ordinary stitching.
Wavy blade forged to vibrate violently against parrying guards. Smiths hate sharpening it; surgeons hate cleaning up after it.

title: Executioner Blade
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Square-tipped and massive, engraved with a scales-and-cinder emblem.
Balanced entirely for downward chopping rather than thrusting. Carried into battle by disgraced judges of the Ember Court.

title: Dreadnought Zweihander
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Parrying lugs below the ricasso bear dents from pike-points.
Six feet of soot-darkened spring alloy built to wade into spear walls. Only men built like draft oxen last a full campaign swinging it.

title: Willow Wand
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Peeling bark reveals wood faintly warm at the tip.
Cut from river-bank trees near Thornwick. Simple, cheap, and prone to snapping if waved too wildly in panic.

title: Yew Wand
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Rust-hued heartwood polished smooth by nervous thumbs.
Carved from graveyard yews older than the Border Fords watchtowers. Channels sparks cleanly without scorching the grip.

title: Amber Focus Wand
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: A trapped prehistoric wasp gleams inside the resin knob.
Turned by Redmarsh craftsmen from bog-dredged amber. Holds static charge like baked wool before a winter storm.

title: Crystal Siphon Wand
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hexagonal quartz core clouds over whenever magic is drawn through it.
Assembled in Oakhaven workshops for field battlemages. Drinks ambient aether faster than wooden foci can manage.

title: Astral Archon Wand
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Star-metal shaft inlaid with white-metal rings that spin softly on their own.
Relic of the pre-schism magisters. Bolts loosed from its tip leave faint violet trails hanging in the air.

title: Ash Shortbow
infobox: Act I Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Stave wrapped in rawhide where damp weather once started a split.
Hunting bow strung with waxed hemp. Quick to draw from behind cover, though weak against mail.

title: Recurve Bow
infobox: Act I–II Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Horn tips laminated onto seasoned ash for extra snap in the draw.
Carried by Redmarsh outriders who shoot from slender causeways. Packs surprising punch for a bow short enough for brush.

title: Composite War Bow
infobox: Act II–III Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Sinew-backed limbs lacquered black against salt spray and drizzle.
Requires a stout back to string and a calloused thumb to loose. Sends bodkins cleanly through nimble shields at a hundred paces.

title: Heavy Arbalest
infobox: Act III–IV Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Metal prod scarred with tally notches along the walnut tiller.
Spanned with a belt-hook and loud enough to wake half a valley. Punches quarrels straight through oak planks and brigandine.

title: Windpiercer Greatbow
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Weapon Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Six-foot yew stave whose string hums a low note even at rest.
Crafted by master bowyers overlooking the Dark-ore Coast cliffs. Arrows loosed from it scream like gulls before striking home.

title: Steel Kite Shield
infobox: Act II–III Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Tapered bottom point chipped from planting it into rocky ground.
Curved face protecting from shoulder to knee. Standard issue for Oakhaven spear-sergeants holding snug-fit bridges.

title: Aegis of the Citadel
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Mirror-bright rim frames a char-stained central boss shaped like a sunburst.
Forged for the personal guard of Ironcamp Citadel. Blows that should shatter bones rebound with a dull, harmless chime.

title: Novice Glass Focus
infobox: Act I Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Blown green bottle-glass full of tiny air bubbles and one hairline crack.
Issued to first-year tower apprentices in Oakhaven. Cheap enough to replace when an overloaded spell shatters it in hand.

title: Chiseled Quartz Focus
infobox: Act I–II Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Faceted milky crystal bound in pewter claws.
Quarried from veins beneath the Border Fords hills. Splits raw magical force into tighter, steadier streams.

title: Astral Sphere
infobox: Act II–III Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hollow brass rings orbit a suspended drop of liquid starlight.
Calibrated by scholars studying the night sky above Redmarsh. Turns softly toward sources of unseen sorcery.

title: Radiant Spell-Mirror
infobox: Act III–IV Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Polished disc framed in bone that reflects faces a second late.
Carried by mage-hunters of the Bloomery Coast. Incoming hexes splash across its surface like water hitting hot griddle.

title: Eye of the Cosmos
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Shield Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: A slit-pupiled gemstone floating inside a cage of biting gold.
Plucked from the crown of a fallen Ember Court oracle. Looking into its depths reveals threads of fate fraying in real time.

title: Steel Basinet
infobox: Act II–III Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Pointed skull-cap with vervelles for hanging a mail aventail.
Sloped crown deflects downward cuts cleanly past the shoulders. Favored by hardened men-at-arms across all four provinces.

title: Dread Crest Helm
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Visor shaped like a snarling hound with soot-stained eye slits.
Forged for shock captains leading assaults into Ember Court territory. Just seeing its silhouette breaks the nerve of raw levies.

title: Apprentice Circlet
infobox: Act I Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Thin brass band tarnished green behind the ears.
Set with a pebble of blue feldspar to help focus wandering thoughts. Every young caster in Oakhaven starts with one.

title: Sage Cowl
infobox: Act II–III Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Coarse slate-hued wool hood lined with faded silk script.
Draped over elders who keep the Lantern Passage archives. Blocks out drafty corridors and stray psychic static alike.

title: Archmage Diadem
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Interlocking crescents cradling a diamond over the brow.
Badge of rank in the Oakhaven conclave. Icy clarity settles behind the eyes the moment it touches the forehead.

title: Stalker Hood
infobox: Act II–III Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Oilskin cowl stained with peat-smoke and leaf-mold to break up silhouettes.
Tailored for Redmarsh pathfinders who move through reeds before dawn. Keeps rain off the neck without muffling footsteps.

title: Shadow Mask
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Helm Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Steeped ebon hide molded featureless save for constricted eye-slits.
Donned by Ember Court night-blades during political purges. Even torchlight seems reluctant to catch on its matte surface.

title: Interlocking Ring Mail
infobox: Act II–III Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Double-linked rings dense enough to stop a bodkin point.
Hauberk oiled with mutton fat against Redmarsh humidity. Moves like metal cloth over a padded gambeson.

title: Gothic Full Plate
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Rippled plates channeled to guide lance tips away from joints.
Masterwork of Ironcamp's finest guildsmiths. Turns a warrior into a walking fortress at the cost of every coin in their chest.

title: Studded Leather Armor
infobox: Act I–II Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hardened oxhide reinforced with rows of domed rivets.
Lighter than mail and quieter in brush. Favored by scouts and caravan guards patrolling the Greywood roads.

title: Hardened Brigandine
infobox: Act II–III Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hundreds of overlapping plates riveted inside crimson canvas.
Looks like a nobleman's doublet until a blade strikes hidden metal. Easy to repair on campaign with a hammer and spare rivets.

title: Wyrmscale Cuirass
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Iridescent scales stitched onto dragon-sinew backing that clinks softly.
Stripped from an elder marsh-wyrm slain after three weeks of siege. Laughs off fire, frost, and blades alike.

title: Weaver Robe
infobox: Act I–II Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Patterned with geometric knots that make the eyes water if stared at.
Loomed by silent guild-weavers in Oakhaven. Each thread is spun around a hair-slender copper filament to ground stray sparks.

title: Mystic Velvet Mantle
infobox: Act III–IV Armor Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Burgundy pile trimmed with ermine stained leaden at the hem.
Draped on advisors in the Ember Court before the fall. Heavy-ply enough to turn aside chill winds and minor hexes.

title: Steel Greaves
infobox: Act III–IV Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hinged shin-guards buckled over wool leggings.
Protect the lower legs from sweeping cuts in shield-wall crushes. Scratched bright along the ankles from rocky trails.

title: Juggernaut War Greaves
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Flanged plate leg-armor sturdy enough to crack cobbles on a hard stomp.
Forged for frontline breachers at Ironcamp Citadel. Once planted, the wearer yields ground only when dead.

title: Tracker Treads
infobox: Act II–III Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Soft-soled deerhide boots laced crosswise up the calf.
Built by border trappers who follow wolf packs across frozen fens. Silent on parched leaves and steady on clammy stone.

title: Windrunner Striders
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Wing-stamped calfskin boots that feel half-empty even when laced taut.
Enchanted in Oakhaven for scouts outrunning cavalry patrols. Dust barely rises behind the heels at a full sprint.

title: Scholar Slippers
infobox: Act I–II Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Felt-soled house shoes ground delicate from pacing library floors.
Quiet enough not to wake snoring archivists in Lantern Passage. Useless in mud, oddly comforting during vigils.

title: Astral Walkers
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Boots Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Midnight-blue boots stitched with sterling thread that leaves faint footprints.
Crafted for tower magisters crossing treacherous planar thresholds. Stones and roots seem to shift out of the wearer's path.

title: Titan War Gauntlets
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Oversized articulated gauntlets scarred from catching falling portcullises.
Forged from dense meteoric alloy for champions of Ironcamp. A lone backhand can cave in a breastplate.

title: Studded Bracers
infobox: Act I–II Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Forearm guards capped with brass strips.
Strapped over sleeves by archers and skirmishers alike. Deflects glancing cuts and keeps bowstrings from bruising wrists.

title: Reinforced Vambraces
infobox: Act II–III Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Spring-metal splints riveted over simmered hide.
Issued to Oakhaven pikemen tired of losing forearms in close press. Nimble enough not to slow a thrust.

title: Shadowstrike Grips
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Supple pitch-dark kidskin gloves with lead-weighted knuckles.
Favored by Ember Court assassins scaling drenched castle walls. Fingers keep full sensitivity while palms bite snug onto stone.

title: Novice Wraps
infobox: Act I Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Inked linen strips wound tightly around knuckles and wrists.
Used by apprentices practicing fire-cantrips before they learn control. Prevents minor burns from blistering the palms.

title: Velvet Channelers
infobox: Act III–IV Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Fingerless crimson gloves embroidered with conduits.
Tailored for battle-casters who need bare fingertips for somatic signs. Draws ambient magic smoothly up the forearms.

title: Archon Handwraps
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Gloves Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Gold-threaded silk bandages that never fray or stain with soot.
Relic bindings carried by the warden of the Celestial Spire. Spells leap from the fingertips with terrifying speed.

title: Copper Band
infobox: Act I Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hammered from a melted-down Border Fords halfpenny.
Leaves a verdigris ring around the finger after a day in the rain. Costs almost nothing and brings modest luck at dice.

title: Bone Ring
infobox: Act I Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Carved from a knuckle-bone smoothed yellow by decades of use.
Sold by grave-diggers outside Thornwick after winter plagues. Chill against the skin whenever undead stir nearby.

title: Ring of Valor
infobox: Act II–III Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Bronze signet stamped with a broken spear.
Awarded to survivors of the Alder Bridge rear-guard. Pulse beats steadier when outnumbered three to one.

title: Ring of the Scribe
infobox: Act II–III Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Argent band shaped like a coiled quill nib.
Kept by clerks in Oakhaven's registry. Ink never blots and spells read faster under its sheen.

title: Ring of the Champions
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Crown-shaped gold band set with three blood-vermilion spinels.
Won in the brutal pit-tournaments of Ironcamp Citadel. Fills the sword-arm with tireless, ruthless strength.

title: Ring of the High Archon
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Platinum loop cradling a star-sapphire that hums when spells are cast.
Passed down among heads of the Oakhaven conclave. Vast reserves of arcane power answer its silent call.

title: Signet of Unbroken Vigor
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Ring Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Seal stamped with an oak root splitting granite.
Carried by marshals who marched across Redmarsh without a sick-day. Wounds knit faster while it rests on the hand.

title: Clay Talisman
infobox: Act I Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Thumb-pressed river clay baked hard and strung on hemp.
Sold at Thornwick market stalls to nervous farmers. Mostly superstition, though it occasionally turns aside a hex.

title: Bronze Locket
infobox: Act I Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Hinged oval case holding a lock of faded hair and dried lavender.
Found in the pack of a soldier who never made it home from Ravenwatch. Keeps a stubborn spark of hope alive in the dark.

title: Astral Medallion
infobox: Act II–III Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Astrolabe pendant whose tiny pointers never stop turning.
Crafted by Redmarsh star-watchers tracking omens over the Ember Court. Sharpens magical focus under unroofed skies.

title: Bloodstone Pendant
infobox: Act II–III Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Moss-hued jasper flecked with crimson spots like fresh splatter.
Carried by Anvil-wrought Coast surgeons and mercenaries alike. Slows bleeding when blades bite deep into flesh.

title: Prismatic Choker
infobox: Act III–IV Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Seven tiny cut gems set in links that flash different colors.
Looted from a ruined Ember Court treasury vault. Scatters incoming elemental magic across the spectrum.

title: Heart of the Colossus
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: Fist-sized banded ruby that thuds softly against the chest plate.
Torn from the chest of an ancient siege-golem beneath Ironcamp. Grants towering endurance to warriors who bear its weight.

title: Medallion of the Celestial Spire
infobox: Act IV & Hard+ Endgame Amulet Drops, Town Merchants & Mystery Gamble

p: A shard of white crystal suspended inside a ring of charcoal star-ferric.
Recovered from the ruin overlooking the Ember Court. Channels blinding celestial authority through its bearer's will.

title: Scroll of Shield Bash
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Slams your shield into an adjacent foe (reach 1), dealing 14-20 physical damage and stunning for 2s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
Drives an iron rim into jaw and ribs to break the guard.

title: Scroll of Cleave Arc
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Sweeps your weapon in a wide front arc (reach 2), hitting up to 3 foes for 18-26 physical damage. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
A wide two-handed sweep meant to clear three pikemen at once.

title: Scroll of Hamstring Cut
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Slices low across a target's leg (reach 1), dealing 12-18 damage and slowing movement by 45% for 5s. Cost: 9 mana, CD: 28.
Low blade-work aimed behind the greave to lame a fleeing foe.

title: Scroll of Sunder Plate
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Crushes enemy armor with a downward blow (reach 1), dealing 20-28 damage and reducing Armor by 12 for 6s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 35.
Heavy overhead impact that splits rivets and dents breastplates.

title: Scroll of Grit Through Pain
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Shrugs off fresh wounds, restoring 28-36 HP and cleansing bleed effects immediately. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 50.
Bites down on leather, binds the rag, and keeps standing.

title: Scroll of Whirlwind Maul
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Spins violently (radius 2), striking all surrounding enemies twice for 15-22 damage per hit. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 55.
A spinning iron storm that punishes any pack closing in.

title: Scroll of Executioner's Blow
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Delivers a massive overhead strike (reach 1) for 34-46 physical damage, dealing +50% to foes below 30% HP. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 60.
No appeals, no ledgers—just a clean parting of head and shoulders.

title: Scroll of Bodkin Shot
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Fires a heavy armor-piercing arrow (reach 9), dealing 18-25 physical damage and ignoring 10 Armor. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
Narrow square-headed iron punched straight through chain links.

title: Scroll of Volley of Reeds
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Rains arrows onto a target area (reach 9, radius 2), dealing 14-20 physical damage to all foes within. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 38.
A whistling sheaf of shafts dropped behind raised pavises.

title: Scroll of Heartseeker
infobox: Act III–IV Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Drawn to full-bend, dealing massive piercing damage with +30% crit.
Takes careful aim at a single distant target (reach 10), dealing 36-48 damage with +30% Crit Chance. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 58.
One held breath, one true release, aimed for the gorget gap.

title: Scroll of Cinder Lance
infobox: Act I–II Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Fires a compressed beam of white-hot ash (reach 8), dealing 20-28 fire damage and igniting for 6/s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
A narrow jet of furnace-flame that pierces shield and surcoat.

title: Scroll of Brine Frost
infobox: Act II–III Arcane Sanctums, Library Chests & Academy Drops

p: Freezes coastal spray over a target area (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 16-22 cold damage and slowing 40% for 4s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 34.
